serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: It’s better to omit certain things from him. I’m sure that as long as he will be with his daughter he will be happy. You: The thing is, your daddy is leaving soon. #Britannia.Face.Normal Britannia: My daddy? Are you kidding me? He’s leaving? I couldn’t care less. You: Yes. We are going to a certain island. Maybe you heard about it. Britannia: An island? You: It’s called Paradisium. #Britannia.Face.Normal Britannia: W-Wait a minute. How did that old prick manage that?! You: He wanted to bring you with him there, but if you are so abhorred by the idea of being with your father I guess I will just tell him you do not want to go. #Britannia.Face.Smile Britannia: W-Wait a minute! We are talking about that island, right? The best island? You: Yep. Britannia: I guess the old fart still has his uses. Paradisium Island, here I go! C-Calling him an old fart… You: You will go? Even after saying all those things about him? #Britannia.Face.Angry Britannia: What? You gonna snitch? You: N-No, that wasn’t my intention… #Britannia.Face.Smile Britannia: It’s not like I’m gonna be stuck with him there. I can always go my separate way! The island is pretty big! You: I guess. Britannia: Good job for telling me this. Sorry for calling you gross I guess, LOL⛤~ You: No offense taken… Britannia: Well then. Lead the way to my father. I kinda forgot where he lives. It’s been so long LOL. You: You can’t be serious…
